newsitem.title: RUSSIA: World Bank's IFC calls for tax reform in Russia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank's IFC calls for tax reform in Russia.

text.p: The head of the World Bank's private-sector arm called on Russia on Friday to reform its tax system to attract foreign investment.

Jannik Lindbaek, Executive Vice-President of the International Finance Corp (IFC), told a news conference that the current tax system, which many investors and businessmen say is arbitary and contradictory, created uncertainty.
"If there's anything an international investor doesn't like, it's uncertainty, so to create a predictable tax system remains a high-priority area for the government," Lindbaek said.
The government has submitted a revised tax code to parliament, and ministers hope that at least elements of this will come into force next year.
